sample_source.location: Table 3, page 700, first row Fo-101 / B-8518
sample_source.transcription: One row manually transcribed and checked against the PDF. Authors report conventional radiocarbon dating of outermost 10–20 surviving tree rings. No raw laboratory counts are supplied.
sample_source.original_calibration: CALIB Rev 5.0 / IntCal04. Reported minimum and maximum two-sigma limits and median, rounded to 10 years.

curve_source.bytes: Original downloaded bytes preserved. Header and all columns retained.

method: Gaussian likelihood on an annual calendar grid, linear interpolation of mean and standard deviation, independent measurement and curve errors, uniform prior 0..55000 cal BP. Equal-tailed 95.4% interval. No reservoir correction, no stratigraphic prior, no tree-ring block averaging. Treats the published sample as one dated carbon aggregate. Year steps are numerical resolution, not dating precision.
scope: New illustrative calibration of a real published measurement, not reproduction of the 2006 IntCal04 calibration and not a revision of the complete glacier chronology.
